findings.note: at 7dd0402 secret-rotation-reminder.yml exists (quarterly deduplicated issue); the Rotation Log still holds only the initial-deployment row + the 2026-10-12 dry-run - no real rotation has been recorded.

findings.title: Web runtime validator can silently fall back to a localhost API URL
findings.note: at 7dd0402 apps/web/lib/env.ts:87-92 throws in production when NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is missing, but the builder/runtime ENV defaults still pre-populate it with http://localhost:4000 (apps/web/Dockerfile:24,47), so a missing build arg bakes localhost instead of tripping the validator; the deploy path always passes it (deploy-do.yml:365).
